title: Install the SDK
cmd: pip install -q -r requirements.txt && pip show anthropic | sed -n 1,2p

title: Check retrieval without the model
cmd: python rulebook.py "How many witnesses can I bring to the hearing?"

title: A question that matches no rule
cmd: python rulebook.py "Should I sue my neighbour over the fence, and will I win?"

title: What a missing key looks like
cmd: python ask.py "How many witnesses can I bring to the hearing?"

title: Ask a question the rulebook covers
cmd: python ask.py "How many witnesses can I bring to the hearing?"

title: Ask for advice and get a refusal
cmd: python ask.py "Should I sue my neighbour over the fence, and will I win?"

title: What a made-up rule number looks like
must_contain: rule 12 which is not in the rulebook
